verdict.rationale: A developer-facing API reference is a fair question for an agent platform, and an api.muse.ai origin exists, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no public API spec, no llms.txt and no discovery route, and nothing about an interactive reference or runnable examples. Muse writing its own connectors to other services' APIs is an adjacent agent capability, not an API reference for users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
